assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original explanatory illustration for a Kopi PowerPoint slide, not a whole slide. Reference image is the existing Kopi mascot and brand style, not an edit target. Style: polished friendly 3D clay-and-satin editorial illustration, softly lit, warm cream #FFFEFA, orange #FF7A1A, peach #FFDDBE and dark charcoal #201D1D, restrained tiny green for success only. Simple concrete composition, readable from across a room, 4:3 landscape. Isolated on genuinely transparent background with generous clear margin. No text, letters, numbers, watermarks, logos of other brands, or full slide layouts. No made-up screenshots of the real application. A laptop with a browser window and the orange Kopi mascot beside it, quietly operating a repeated task. A small completion tick on the browser and a subtle loop around two browser tabs communicate background browser automation. One coherent scene, no extra decorative objects.
